title: Safety & Environment
description: COR certified health and safety program, a Construction Safety Officer and a toolbox meeting every shift. Environmental care on every site.

hero.title: Everyone home.
hero.subtitle: Safety is how we plan, price and run every job. It is the first thing we talk about every morning.

image.alt: NSC crew in hard hats and vests on the Guildford Park detention tank

blocks.title: A program, not a poster.
blocks.intro: Our Certificate of Recognition confirms an audited health and safety program. It is backed by people on site every day: a Construction Safety Officer, experienced superintendents and foremen, and crews who look out for each other.

items.title: COR certified
items.text: Our health and safety program is audited and certified under the Certificate of Recognition program of the BC Construction Safety Alliance.

items.title: Safety officer on our sites
items.text: A dedicated Construction Safety Officer monitors site activity, identifies hazards and works with every crew on compliance.

items.title: Toolbox meeting every shift
items.text: Every day starts with a toolbox meeting: the day’s tasks, the hazards that come with them and how we control them.

items.title: Excavation and shoring
items.text: Trench boxes, shoring and safe access on every excavation, checked before anyone goes in.

items.title: Locates before we dig
items.text: Pre-locates, BC 1 Call and soil sampling before the first sawcut, so we know what is in the ground.

items.title: Traffic and public safety
items.text: Traffic management plans, flaggers and fenced work zones keep the public, students and residents clear of the work.

blocks.title: Audited. Certified.
blocks.text: COR is awarded to employers whose health and safety programs meet the provincial standard, verified by an external audit. For owners and construction managers it means a contractor whose program is documented, audited and in use on every site.

blocks.title: Good neighbours on every site.
blocks.intro: Our work happens in neighbourhoods, schoolyards and campuses. We plan it to protect the ground, the water and the people around us.

items.title: Erosion and sediment control
items.text: Sediment control measures on every site to keep soil and runoff out of storm systems and waterways.

items.title: Good Neighbour programs
items.text: Before we mobilize we review local bylaws and Good Neighbour programs for noise, dust, access and work hours.

items.title: Occupied sites
items.text: Schools, campuses and homes stay open while we work. At Queen Elizabeth Elementary, sewer work was scheduled over spring break.

items.title: Services kept running
items.text: On Kingston Road, every property stayed connected while new sewer and water services were built and transferred.

blocks.title: Prequalifying contractors?
blocks.text: We provide our safety program documentation, COR certificate and prequalification package on request.
